notes.title: 无双模式添加，性能优化
notes.content:
新版本添加新的无双模式玩法，画质优化，增强视觉效果，游戏化性能，手柄操控优化，添加新的敌人。。
The new version adds new dual-mode gameplay, optimized graphics quality, enhanced visual effects, gamification performance, optimized controller control, and new enemies..
